proposed.explanation: The net profit belonging to Talaat Moustafa Group Holding's (TMGH) shareholders grew from 9,025,066,065 LE in 2024 to 14,383,890,306 LE in 2025, representing a strong growth of 5,358,824,241 LE or approximately 59.4%. Furthermore, consolidated net profit for the year reached 18,201,981,482 LE in 2025 compared to 12,769,517,325 LE in 2024, and earnings per share rose from 4.38 LE to 6.98 LE. While these robust financial results demonstrate excellent performance and support the investor's long-term growth goal, the investor already holds 500 shares of TMGH currently valued at 41,250.00 EGP against 30,000.00 EGP in cash (total portfolio value 71,250.00 EGP). Buying additional shares would increase the TMGH holding value above 50% of the total portfolio value (which would exceed 35,625.00 EGP), violating the portfolio diversification rule. Therefore, the recommended action is to hold the existing position without adding more shares.
